description: Architecture no longer screams the scenario's domain boundaries: the API is a monolithic package and the docs drift from actual layout. Evidence: `api/main.go` wires 20+ services into a single `Server` (lines 33-67) and `api/routes.go` registers 18 domain groups from one file (lines 9-29). The architecture doc's UI tree lists `ui/src/app/App.tsx` + `shared/components`, but the actual entrypoint is `ui/src/App.tsx` importing shared UI from `shared/ui` (App.tsx lines 1-11), and a `surfaces/user-auth` surface exists (App.tsx line 43) that is not documented. Backend docs also list `api/initialization/postgres`, while schema lives under `initialization/postgres/`. Target: make domain boundaries explicit (API/UI), reduce god entrypoints, and bring architecture/manifest docs into sync; documentation health >=95% with missing docs addressed. Reproduce: `sed -n '33,120p' scenarios/landing-page-business-suite/api/main.go`, `sed -n '9,30p' scenarios/landing-page-business-suite/api/routes.go`, `sed -n '90,140p' scenarios/landing-page-business-suite/docs/concepts/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `sed -n '1,45p' scenarios/landing-page-business-suite/ui/src/App.tsx`, `knowledge-observatory docs health -json -scenario landing-page-business-suite`.
name: qa-deep-landing-page-business-suite-screaming-architecture-20260408
title: Align landing-page-business-suite architecture with domain boundaries + docs
